reference_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN units >= 3 THEN 'bulk'
            WHEN net_revenue_eur >= 500 THEN 'big_ticket'
            ELSE 'regular'
       END AS line_type,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
       SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
FROM sales
GROUP BY line_type
